subject: 广胜寺飞虹塔
author: Artsxiang
source_note: 全塔近正面，十三层琉璃塔身及首层回廊。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古. Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. All other images are SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY; never draw the Buddha. Create refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line art. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; doors and windows are outlines, never black fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, hatching, texture, pencil grain, gradient, color or gold. The white will become transparent and the ink uniformly gold on the website. Show complete architecture centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Only a few short ground lines. Remove people, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, fences and unrelated buildings. Selectively preserve architectural ornament without tracing every roof tile or brick. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, caption, watermark, frame or border. Subject: Feihong Pagoda 飞虹塔 of Guangsheng Temple, Hongtong, actual photo 2. Faithfully outline the complete front-facing octagonal glazed brick tower including its wide, low wooden colonnaded porch at ground. Above the porch, thirteen clearly separated stacked main glazed pagoda storeys and their eaves rise in a strong taper, with the lower two glazed storeys taller and more ornate. Observe the exact horizontal level divisions in photo 2 and reproduce them without dropping any; this tower is known as a THIRTEEN-storey pagoda. Small arched niches on front faces, selective outlined bracket and guardian decoration, tapered ornate finial at top. Remove surrounding halls, flags, shrubs, tourists and courtyard. Clear frontal elevation, subtle octagonal adjacent faces, verticals upright; full tower 82% portrait 1024×1536 height with base and finial uncut. Very fine contour drawing, not textured engraving. All roof planes and wall fields white with only a few thin defining lines and miniature niche outlines. No dark fills or dense tile grids.

historical_sources.title: 飞虹塔
historical_sources.note: 维基百科，二手来源；达连募资、正德十年至嘉靖六年、八角十三层、高47.6米、琉璃构件、1556与1695两次地震，其注引连达《得乎檐角梁柱间》。

historical_sources.title: 广胜寺
historical_sources.note: 维基百科，二手来源；塔在元代原址重建、高47.31米、中国最大琉璃塔、1961年第一批国保、下寺壁画1928年售出、1986年《西游记》取景。

historical_sources.title: 国务院关于公布第一批全国重点文物保护单位名单的通知
